title: Golden Arrows Dataset V3.0 Advanced Swarm Behavior Schema
description: Schema for the Advanced Swarm Behavior telemetry recorded in each drone behavior object. This telemetry is generated by the scripted Advanced Swarm Behavior system used during V3.0 data generation and is distinct from actual physical movement recorded separately under actual_movement.

current_position.description: Current drone position associated with the behavior calculation.

current_velocity.description: Current velocity vector recorded for the behavior calculation.

desired_velocity.description: Desired velocity vector associated with the behavior system.

movement_vector.description: Behavior-generated movement vector recorded by the Advanced Swarm Behavior system. This is distinct from the separately recorded actual_movement.

speed_scale.description: Recorded speed scale applied in the behavior calculation.

neighbor_count.description: Number of neighboring drones used by the behavior calculation.

minimum_neighbor_distance.description: Minimum relevant neighboring-drone distance recorded by the behavior system.

formation_error.description: Recorded formation error value associated with the behavior computation.

connectivity_risk.description: Behavior telemetry value representing the calculated connectivity risk signal.

boundary_risk.description: Behavior telemetry value representing the calculated boundary risk signal.

behaviors.description: Collection of the seven Advanced Swarm Behavior components recorded for the drone.

vector2.description: Two-dimensional numeric vector expressed as [x, y].

x.description: X coordinate of the component vector.

y.description: Y coordinate of the component vector.

weight.description: Configured contribution weight for the behavior component.

cohesion.description: Movement tendency toward the local/swarm center.

alignment.description: Movement tendency related to neighboring drone motion/alignment.

separation.description: Movement tendency away from nearby drones to preserve spacing.

formation.description: Movement tendency related to the configured formation geometry.

target_attraction.description: Movement tendency toward the active mission target.

network_preservation.description: Movement tendency related to maintaining network/connectivity conditions.

boundary_avoidance.description: Movement tendency away from unsafe proximity to simulation boundaries.
